Name: Yellow Dirt Removal Patch for 1.1
Author: Ebeths
Description:
An update of the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/178/?]Yellow Dirt Removal Mod[/url] so that it runs without graphical errors for Stardew Valley Version 1.1. This patch was uploaded with the original mod's author's permission.

Replaces all dirt with grass in Spring, Summer and Fall for a better looking farm and town.

Unzip the files and place them in the content folder- make sure to backup your content folder first!

Please let me know if you find any bugs & enjoy :)

House featured in the example images is the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/420/?]Witchy Gothic Building Mod[/url]

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
